term: source-cause of esse by another actual agent in the q.3 a.4 test
definition: HasExternalEsseCause p x means that an actual being y distinct from x stands in CausesIn y x p.esse. It models an external efficient cause at the being-respect. It is not identical to q.104's continuing conservation of esse or to a noncausal explanation token of an existence fact.
note: A type-safe interpretation of the sourced 'causatum ab alio'. The translation from natural-language causation to CausesIn at esse is explicit and open to critique; no general PSR or conservation bridge is built into the definition.
